fusions.name: Snared Strand
fusions.desc: Casts a strand at the first enemy it meets that deals 9 damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, with a 50% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Loom Curtain
fusions.desc: Hangs a curtain of strands 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. It deals 11 damage to each enemy that crosses it, stuns it for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Ten Thousand Snares
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 3 tiles in place for 2 seconds and leaves each [Pinned].

fusions.name: Split Ends
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage. Your armour rises by 4%.
